request.description: The questions for a stage, resolved for this application's segment, sub-segment and category and the facts already known, plus questions lenders and scoring still need (progressive profiling, `progressive[]`). Borrower context (the applicant's own records, reached through their login); partner context sees applications its firm filed (M3c). Lists and reads never show other people's records.
